Subject: QBR demo orchestration — runbook, owner rotation & venue options

Hi Taylor —

We’re locking the agenda for Meridian’s renewal QBR + roadmap demo and want to confirm logistics so we ship a crisp experience for both execs and technical stakeholders. Two options we recommend (high level):

1) Remote focused (preferred for speed)
   - 90-minute demo + 30-minute exec breakout (recorded)
   - Short hands-on tech breakout with CS/SEs after the recording
   - Lower ops burden, easy recording & distribution

2) Hybrid / on-site half day (if leadership wants in-person)
   - 3.5 hours: exec walkthrough, live demo, 2x 30-min tech deep dives
   - Requires AV + local host and one backup engineer on-call

Two operational asks from our side:
- Can you confirm which format Meridian prefers (remote vs hybrid)?
- Preferred timezone windows the week of Apr 23–27 (we have East Coast coverage 10a–4p ET)
- Any additional attendees who need the SOC2/data handling deep dive? We can add a 20-min compliance slot.

Internal note: Monica will be primary demo owner; Laura will be backup owner and lead the canary run. Marissa will manage invites and recording logistics. We’ll attach the current deck and a short runbook for the tech breakout.

Attachments: QBR-roadmap-deck-v3.pdf (deck stub)

Thanks — quick thumbs up on preferred format and 3 windows that work for you and your team.

Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
